categories.name: validation
categories.evidence: Touches src/dbwrapper.cpp, which validation explicitly covers for LevelDB database wrappers, and carries the 'UTXO Db and Indexes' label.
categories.rationale: The change reallocates unused 64-bit LevelDB block cache memory to write buffers, but benchmarks show no meaningful impact. Testing reindex-chainstate across x86_64 and aarch64 showed no significant runtime difference (within 1-2% variance), leaving this as a marginal tuning adjustment with little measurable benefit.
